name: Almost Heaven Seneca 4-6 Person Barrel Sauna, 7x7 ft.
description: Almost Heaven Seneca 7'x7' DIY Barrel Sauna Kit The Almost Heaven Seneca is made for comfort. Measuring 7'x7', it is a full foot wider than the standard barrel sauna and can fit up to six people—or enjoy all the extra space solo! The Almost Heaven Seneca also has wider benches, which can hold people, water, towels, and even logs if you opt to upgrade to a wood-burning heater. This sauna comes with a larger glass door—enjoy the extra foot of natural light! The Almost Heaven Seneca 6-person barrel sauna comes standard with a Harvia 8kW electric heater, which gets the space up to 180ºF and beyond. The sauna can start heating right away, or you can delay the start time by up to eight hours. Stretch out solo in all the extra space or invite friends or the whole family to join; the choice is yours! Features Below are some features and specifications of the Almost Heaven Seneca 6-person barrel sauna: Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Western cedar heater guard Weather-proof polymer support cradles Two wider benches, opposite-facing, for sitting or reclining Two exterior opposite-facing benches Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Best-in-class heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Exterior dimensions of the Almost Heaven Seneca are 84"W x 84"L x 88"H. Interior dimensions are 79"W x 75"D x 85"H. Bench dimensions are 20″W x 75″L x 22″H. Cradle dimensions are 54" x 6". Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Lumber type: The Almost Heaven Seneca 6-person barrel sauna is built with solid rustic cedar. Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. You can choose between red rustic cedar or onyx rustic cedar (stained). All three lumber options of the Seneca 6-person barrel sauna are 1 ⅜” thick to insulate the sauna room. Vista rear window: This is one of our saunas’ most popular glass features. Open the barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the vista rear window. This 20” x 36” piece of 3/8” glass sits on the back end barrel, above the electric heater. Let more natural light in your sauna! Door style: The Almost Heaven Seneca has a larger glass door.But you can outfit your sauna with any of the following three door options: deluxe glass, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Heater: The Almost Heaven Seneca 6-person barrel sauna comes standard with an 8kW electric, and you can upgrade it to a Virta deluxe heater or a wood-burning heater with a chimney kit. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping & Assembly The Almost Heaven Seneca will ship via an LTL truck. See shipping tab for more details. Compared to Almost Heaven’s standard barrel sauna, the Seneca requires mid-level handyman and assembly skills are recommended for this sauna. Minimal sawing or modifying certain components may be necessary during the assembly process. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6-8 hours. It is recommended that you review the installation manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential sauna accessories for a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity.
